author: m. s. miner
title: White student enrollment at Lowville Elementary drops to 532 in 2025-26
text:
Lowville Elementary School registered 532 white students enrolled in the 2025-26 school year, a decrease of 6.2% compared with the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
The data indicated the school had a total enrollment of 591 students in the 2025-26 school year. White students accounted for 90% of the population, making them the predominant ethnic group at the school.
The facility is part of the Lowville Academy & Central School District and is headquartered in Lowville.
Out of the district’s three schools, Lowville Elementary had the highest count of white students at that time.
World Population Review’s analysis found that New York’s public education system was ranked second nationally overall , but held the 31st spot for K-12 performance.
